verdict.rationale: v0 lets users push/export generated code to GitHub in a standard, open format (docs-2, docs-31, docs-39), and the API docs mention generic 'Export capabilities for backup and migration' (docs-43), supporting a degree of data portability. However there's no concrete evidence of exporting full account data (chat history, project settings, credentials) in open formats, and no independent confirmation the export path is complete or lock-in-free. Missing for 10: evidence of exporting non-code data (chats, project metadata, integrations config), a documented full-account export/download feature, and independent verification that migrated projects run outside v0/Vercel without further dependency.
